text:
Breakfast with a Stranger

As I slid into the booth at the local diner, I couldn't help but feel a sense of relief wash over me. It had been a long week, and all I wanted was a hot cup of coffee and a plate of pancakes to start my day off right. I perused the menu, my stomach growling in anticipation, when the waitress came to take my order.

"What can I get for you, sweetheart?" she asked with a warm smile.

"I'll have the eggs over easy, toast, and a cup of coffee, please," I replied, feeling a sense of normalcy wash over me.

As I waited for my food to arrive, I took a sip of my coffee and pulled out my phone to check the time. I had a big day ahead of me, and I needed to make the most of it. Just as I was starting to feel like I was going to have to wait a bit longer for my food, the waitress returned with a plate in front of me.

But as I looked down at the plate, my heart sank. Instead of the eggs and toast I had ordered, there was a plate of oatmeal in front of me, topped with fresh fruit and a drizzle of honey. I was about to speak up when I noticed a small piece of paper tucked under the edge of the plate.

I picked it up, and my heart skipped a beat as I read the simple message scrawled on the paper: "It's time." I felt a shiver run down my spine as I looked up to see if anyone was watching me, but the waitress was busy taking orders from a table in the corner.

I took a deep breath and tried to shake off the feeling of unease. Maybe it was just a prank, I told myself. But as I looked back at the note, I couldn't shake the feeling that it was more than that. It was as if someone was trying to tell me something, but I had no idea what.

I tried to focus on my food, but my mind kept wandering back to the note. What did it mean? Was it a warning? A message from someone who knew something I didn't? I pushed the thoughts aside and took a bite of my oatmeal, but the taste was bitter on my tongue.

As I finished my meal and prepared to leave, I caught a glimpse of the waitress out of the corner of my eye. She was watching me, a knowing look in her eyes. I felt a chill run down my spine as I realized that I had no idea what was going on, but I had a feeling that my life was about to change in ways I couldn't even imagine.
question: What unexpected event happened to the narrator at the diner?
options: The diner ran out of food.
A stranger joined them for breakfast.
They received a meal with a mysterious note.
